## Type

- [ ] New profession archetype (`archetypes/<slug>.md`)
- [ ] Fix to an existing archetype
- [ ] Docs or README
- [ ] Other (explain above)

## Checklist

- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate.py` passes locally
- [ ] Archetype: every line is hedged ("tend to", "often"); no statistics, salary figures, or named employers; licensing claims point at an official body
- [ ] Archetype: I said in one line what my connection to the profession is (I do it / I hire for it / I recruit for it)
- [ ] Nothing here makes the plugin send, submit, accept, or decline on a user's behalf
- [ ] I did not edit files under `job-search-os/` or `docs/` (they are mirrored from the build repo; open a skill-idea issue instead)
